notes: dsh-web = Walter Engine (the single production runtime, Engine API :8895); walter-telegram = its Telegram door (owner's bot); cloudflared-tunnel and tailscaled = ingress. Restarting dsh-web interrupts a running turn: only when it is down or its API does not answer. Hermes is retired (2026-11-10): never restart it.

deploy:stale:<unit> = the service started before the code it loads last changed on disk (shared library fixed, credentials changed): it still runs the old code in RAM. The repair is restart_stale (walter deploy restart <unit>): it re-checks staleness itself, defers dsh-web and walter-telegram while an engine turn is in flight, restarts a unit at most once per hour, then checks again (rc 0 = restarted and fresh, nothing to do, or deferred to a later pass; rc 1 = still stale or down after the restart). Restarting a stale service is routine and reversible; tell Monsieur only if it stays stale after two restarts.

restart_unit.describe: restart an engine, door or ingress service

restart_stale.describe: restart a service running code older than the code on disk (gated in code: re-checked, deferred while an engine turn is in flight, once per hour per service)
